tool_input.plan:
# FinLife Simulator â†’ 3D Island ## Context The user wants to convert their existing FinLife Simulator (`bitlife-finance.html`, 6,204 lines, deployed at https://noahmbrown2-pixel.github.io/finlife-simulator/) from a flat mobile-app-style UI into a 3D first-person island game. The transformation: - **Map** â†’ small island the player walks around on - **10 action squares** (Bank, Stocks, Crypto, Real Estate, Education, Fitness, Sponsors, Inbox, Table, +Age) â†’ **buildings** placed on the island - **6 tabs** (Life, Finances, Business, Work, Invest, Assets) â†’ **6 apps on a phone** the player carries - **Camera**: first-person - **Visual style**: flat 2.5D â€” building art is flat textured panels (Doom-style billboards) sitting on a 3D ground - **Time**: replace the "Age +1 Month" button with sleeping at home - **Phone**: hidden by default; press **Tab** to bring it up The goal is to preserve **all existing game logic** (5,600+ lines of finance/career/sports/inbox/investments) untouched, and simply change how the player interacts with it. ## Strategy: Reuse, don't rewrite Create a **new file** `finlife-3d.html` as a copy of `bitlife-finance.html`, with the UI shell modified and a 3D scene layered on top. Crucially: - All game state (`GS`, `createChar`, `createInvState`, `tickMonth`/`annualTick`), modals (`openModal`/`closeModal`), tab content rendering, and save/load (`finlife_save` localStorage key) stay **untouched** - The original 10 action buttons stay in the DOM but are **hidden via CSS** â€” the 3D buildings simply call `document.getElementById('btn-bank').click()` etc., so every existing handler keeps working - The 6 `.tab-content` divs stay in the DOM â€” they're just **moved inside a `.phone-overlay` container** that toggles on Tab key - The original `bitlife-finance.html` is **left alone** so the live GitHub Pages site keeps working This is the smallest surface area change that delivers the whole feature. ## Files | Path | Action | |------|--------| | `C:\Users\noahm\Project\finlife-3d.html` | **New** â€” copy of `bitlife-finance.html` with modified shell + 3D scene | | `C:\Users\noahm\Project\bitlife-finance.html` | **Untouched** (reference only) | | `C:\Users\noahm\Project\CLAUDE.md` | Add one-line entry under "Project Structure" | ## Implementation steps ### 1. Bootstrap the new file - `cp bitlife-finance.html finlife-3d.html` - Add Three.js CDN in ``: `` - Add a `` as the first child of `#screen-game` (fills the viewport) ### 2. Modify the existing shell (CSS only â€” no JS handlers touched) - **Hide the original right panel and tabs**: `#right-panel{display:none}` `.tabs-bar{display:none}` `#left-panel{display:none}` â€” they exist in DOM so handlers still work, just invisible - **Move the 6 `.tab-content` divs** (`#tab-life`, `#tab-finances`, `#tab-business`, `#tab-work`, `#tab-invest`, `#tab-assets`) into a new `
` wrapper using a small DOM-move snippet at startup - Keep `#modal-overlay` and `#toast` exactly as they are â€” they already render on top of everything ### 3. Build the phone overlay UI Structure (new HTML inserted into `#screen-game`): ```
$money Â· Age N Â· Mon Year
``` - App icon click: hide `.phone-home`, slide selected `#tab-{name}` into `.phone-app-content`, show back button - **Tab key** (and on-screen ðŸ“± button for mobile) toggles `.phone-overlay.open` - When phone is open, release pointer lock and freeze player movement; on close, re-lock pointer ### 4. Build the 3D island scene At startup, after `showScreen('game')`: - Three.js scene + perspective camera (FOV 75) + WebGLRenderer attached to `#world3d` - **Sky**: gradient using `scene.background` set to a vertical-gradient texture (sunset/day blue) - **Sun**: `THREE.DirectionalLight` + ambient light - **Water**: large blue `PlaneGeometry` 200Ã—200 at y=-0.2, slight transparency - **Island ground**: circular green plane (radius ~30) at y=0, with a sandy ring (radius ~32) underneath - **Decoration**: scatter ~20 tree billboards (flat textured planes that always face camera) for atmosphere - **Skybox horizon fog**: `scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(skyColor, 30, 80)` so the world fades into haze ### 5. Buildings as billboards (the 10 actions) Each building is a flat textured `THREE.Sprite` (or PlaneGeometry with `lookAt(camera)` per frame), with a Canvas-drawn texture (pixel-art style: house base + emoji icon + label). [Confirm] [Cancel]"` - Confirm calls `document.getElementById('btn-age').click()` â€” which already runs `annualTick()` (line 5052) and triggers all extras hooks (line 6126) - The `#btn-age` element stays in the hidden DOM so the existing hook chain (extras at line 6125â€“6126) keeps working ### 8.
